description: React component for a development planning UI, managing stateful user interactions with plans and plan items, including loading, editing, saving, exporting to PDF, and integrating with a backend via API calls and database operations.

methods.name: encodeMetaDescription
methods.description: Encodes phase, priority, and status metadata into the description string using a separator.

methods.name: decodeMetaDescription
methods.description: Decodes the description string to extract the original description and metadata (phase, priority, status).

methods.name: DevPlan
methods.description: Main React functional component that renders the development plan interface, manages state, and handles user interactions like adding, editing, saving, exporting, and deleting plan items.
